Ohio Community Well-Being

Conditions in every Ohio county, congressional district and census tract, in nine areas of daily life. Each measure is shown in its own units next to Ohio, the U.S. and, where one exists, a published standard. Nothing here is combined into a single score.

Working draft, November 17, 2026. The figures were recomputed from the publishers by independent checks on November 17, 2026, and the fixes they called for were rechecked.
